reconstruction_notes.en: Fossil-specimen / specimen scope only: five broad partially joined sepals, a shallow central cup and restrained major veins. No inferred corolla, stamen array, stem-root system or whole mother plant. Nominal span, muted fossil palette and gentle three-dimensional thickness are artistic; not a measured replica or modern five-petal flower.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 仅 fossil-specimen / specimen 范围：五枚宽大部分连合的萼片、浅中央杯与克制主脉。不推测完整花冠、雄蕊阵列、茎根或母株。名义跨度、化石配色和轻微三维厚度为美术选择，非实测复制品或现代五瓣花。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
